evidence_ref: Pass 2 pre-merge review of PR #187 at head a23a15e. Targeted Playwright probes (chromium+firefox) against packages/elements/dist/elements.js verified all four pass-1 fixes (probe ordering, null-vs-undefined, onInput buffer, label/aria-describedby/customError) as CORRECT, plus 12 static gates green after the train rebase. Found 1 HIGH regression introduced by the onInput fix (validate() has no re-entry path when the control's validity changes but no reactive property does -> field permanently blocks submission on a value the inner control reports valid), 2 MEDIUM (falsified comment invariant on the new badInput branch; react-wrapper gate case-folding weakens the casing assertion and its stated 'all case-only' premise is falsified by class->className and for->htmlFor in the installed generator). Verdict: BLOCK.
